scenes.name: SIX TURNS
lines: Take the six integer quaternions of norm five: one plus or minus two i, j, or k.
取六枚模方为 5 的整四元数：1 ± 2i、1 ± 2j、1 ± 2k。
Right-multiply a point of the three-sphere by each, then sum the six values.
把三维球面上的一点分别右乘这六枚旋子，再把函数的六个值加起来。
This sum is the Hecke operator. How fast does it flatten mean-zero patterns?
这个和就是赫克算子。它把均值为零的花纹抹平得有多快？
The Ramanujan bound is two root five. Square it: twenty minus lambda squared is never negative.
拉马努金界是 2√5。两边平方：20 − λ̂² 永不为负。

scenes.name: THE UNIT CIRCLE
lines: Why a square? Factor one minus lambda X plus five X squared, and scale both roots by root five.
为什么是平方？把 1 − λ̂X + 5X² 分解成两个因子，再把两个根按 √5 归一化。
The two parameters multiply to one; their Toeplitz determinant is twenty minus lambda squared, over five.
两个参数之积为 1；它们的托普利茨行列式是 (20 − λ̂²)/5。
Lean checks the general rule: the matrix is positive semidefinite exactly when every parameter lies on the unit circle.
Lean 内核检验了一般法则：这样的托普利茨矩阵半正定，当且仅当每个参数都落在单位圆上。

scenes.name: THE BOUNDARY
lines: This bridge is a criterion about finite families, not a theorem about the zeros of zeta.
这座桥是关于有限复数族的判据，不是关于 ζ 零点的定理。
Lubotzky, Phillips and Sarnak proved the full bound; reading it as critical-line optimality is the book's model.
Lubotzky、Phillips 与 Sarnak 证明了全谱界（文献结果）；把它读作临界线最优性，是本书的模型诠释。
Higher-rank Ramanujan–Petersson and the extended Riemann hypothesis stay open.
高秩拉马努金—彼得松猜想与数域的扩展黎曼猜想，仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: MINUS TWO FIFTHS
lines: One exact case: the spin-one character is three w squared minus the other squares, over the norm.
一个精确算例：自旋 1 特征标 χ₁ 是 3w² 减去其余三个平方，再除以模方。
At q equals two, one, three, minus one, the six scalar parts are zero, four, minus four, eight, four, zero.
The squares add to one hundred twelve, and the sum is minus two fifths of chi, computed here.
平方和为 112，算子作用的结果恰是 χ₁ 的 −2/5 倍（屏幕计算）。
Lean checks this for every nonzero integer quaternion, and the positive margin, four ninety-six over twenty-five.
Lean 内核对一切非零整四元数检验了这一点，也检验了正的裕度 496/25。

scenes.name: SHELL TRACES
lines: Higher shells obey one integer rule: minus six times the last numerator, minus twenty-five times the one before.
更高的壳层服从同一条整数递推：前一个分子的 −6 倍，再减去更前一个的 25 倍。
Lean checks the rule and the six values, up to sixteen thousand nine hundred one over five to the sixth.
Lean 内核检验了这条递推与前六个值：从 −1/5 一直到 16901/15625。
Representation theory reads each value as the trace on a shell of dimension three to thirteen.
表示论推导把每个值认作一个壳层上的迹，壳层维数从 3 到 13。

scenes.name: DEGREE FOUR
lines: Skip the root: six Gaussian integer matrices sum to six, minus two, and minus eighteen times the identity.
先不除根号：六枚高斯整矩阵之和依次是 6、−2、−18 倍的单位阵。
In degree four the corners couple by sixty-four, splitting into fifty-four twice and minus seventy-four three times.
到了四次，首尾两角以 64 耦合，分裂为二重的 54 与三重的 −74。
Lean checks the matrices, five eigenlines and margins; exact minors certify shells three to six.
Lean 内核检验了这些矩阵、五条本征线与裕度；第 3 至第 6 壳由精确主子式核验。

scenes.name: A FINITE GRAPH
lines: Reduce the six turns modulo thirteen: five is not a square there, so each step crosses between two halves of twenty-one eighty-four vertices.
把六个转动模 13 约化：5 不是模 13 的平方，所以每一步都在两半之间跨越，共 2184 个顶点，每半 1092 个。
No cycle is shorter than eight, and five to the eighth gives the witness two eighty-seven, four sixteen, three sixty-four, fifty-two.
An exact shift certificate keeps every nontrivial squared value below nineteen, inside the Ramanujan twenty.
精确移位证书使每个非平凡的平方奇异值都小于 19，落在拉马努金界 20 之内。

scenes.name: END
lines: Six integer turns, one squared inequality, and a gap you can check with fractions.
六个整数转动，一条平方后的不等式，一道用分数就能核验的谱隙。
